description: This file defines a Java class LoanTransactionDataV1Enricher that implements data enrichment for LoanTransactionDataV1 objects. It uses repositories and mappers to enrich loan transaction data with external owner IDs.

classes.name: LoanTransactionDataV1Enricher
classes.description: A Spring component that enriches LoanTransactionDataV1 data objects with external owner IDs by querying the transfer repository and using an ID mapper.

methods.name: isDataTypeSupported
methods.description: Checks if the provided data type is supported by this enricher, specifically if it's assignable from LoanTransactionDataV1.

methods.name: enrich
methods.description: Enrichs the LoanTransactionDataV1 object by fetching the active owner for the loan and setting its external owner ID on the data object.
